mappings.reasoning: Short Text is for single-line free text.
Long Text allows multiple lines of free text.
Whole Number captures integers and typically supports min/max.
Decimal Number accepts fractional values with possible bounds.
Calendar Date stores a date without time.
Clock Time stores a time of day without a date.
Date & Clock combines date and time in one field.
Yes / No expresses exactly two states explicitly.
Picklist is a collapsed one-of dropdown.
Multi-Pick allows selecting zero or more choices.
Option Group shows all choices and allows exactly one selection.
Tick Box is a single on/off checkbox.
Derived Value is computed from other fields, not user-entered.

notes: Critical distinction: Multi-Pick (multi_select list of coded options) vs Tick Box (single checkbox).
Picklist maps to single_select (collapsed dropdown) while Option Group maps to radio (all options visible, pick one).
Yes / No and Tick Box both represent two states; prefer Yes / No for explicit binary answers, Tick Box for a single affirmative flag.
Derived Value is likely read-only and formula-driven; confirm how its data type (numeric/text/date) is set if needed.
Confirm whether Option Group can ever be configured for multi-select; if so, ensure Multi-Pick is used for multi-select use cases.
Validate any timezone/seconds behavior for Clock Time and Date & Clock, and units/min/max handling for numeric fields.
